title: PlantNow
description: Real-time state of a single solar power plant. Returned by `plant_now(plant_id)`.

current_kw.description: Current AC output in kilowatts. Returns 0 at night. NEVER negative — if the API reports negative values (sensor noise), clamp to 0.

today_kwh.description: Cumulative AC yield today, in kilowatt-hours. Resets at local midnight.

status.description: Operational status rollup. `online` = at least one inverter producing or capable of producing (night-time idle counts as online if no fault). `offline` = comms lost. `fault` = active fault preventing production. `maintenance` = operator-set. `unknown` = vendor couldn't determine.

alarms_count.description: Number of active alarms on this plant. Detail available via `inverter_alarms(plant_id)`.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this reading was sampled by the vendor's API. NOT the wall-clock at the moment of MCP call — use the vendor's own freshness signal.

capacity_kwp.description: Optional. Echoed from `Plant.capacity_kwp` if cheap to include — saves a `plant_list` round-trip when the consumer needs the ratio `current_kw / capacity_kwp`.
